authorization: User explicitly asked to continue cloud methodology/observation review after full-path vs endpoint distinction. This authorizes a separate diagnostic, not retroactive amendment of the original v1 PASS/FAIL gates.

methodological_decision.derivation: A horizon terminal return d*(P[t+h]/P[t]-1) depends on entry and exit prices only. The paired increment requires four endpoints, not all 482 path prices. Requiring every intermediate bar to trade selects a different full-path-observable population and is necessary for complete minute-path extrema, not for the algebra of terminal returns.
methodological_decision.old_protocol: R1A_CARRIER_PRICE_TRANSPORT_FREEZE@1.0 remains byte-for-byte unchanged. Its primary insufficient-coverage decision and PARTIAL_CARRIER_TRANSPORT history remain valid.
methodological_decision.new_target: Descriptive paired ETF terminal returns conditional on both original event and control having positive-volume, valid prices at their exact fixed entry and horizon-exit timestamps. Not all-event alpha, causal treatment effect, execution PnL or a replacement full-path admission.
methodological_decision.future_availability_conditioning: Eligibility uses exit availability and therefore is retrospective, not a causal tradable entry rule. Missingness may be informative. No MCAR/MAR assumption, weighting or imputation is asserted.
methodological_decision.separate_path_estimand: Do not compute MFE/MAE, stops, targets or intrapath risk on this endpoint sample. Original full-path evidence stays separate.

data_integrity.reuse: Check pinned checklist, manifests and every CSV SHA256/size/rows; validate canonical OHLCV identity, duplicates, time labels and action-ledger schema. Do not claim fresh upstream exchange verification.
data_integrity.record_coverage_definition: Fraction of index-clock timestamps with an actual delivered valid-OHLCV row, including zero-volume rows as records only, not as usable return endpoints.
data_integrity.positive_volume_coverage: Always report independently; do not label zero-volume minutes as traded or change their values.
data_integrity.source_caveats: Delivered canonical time and corporate-action provenance is inherited and documented. Source-recorded volume=0 vs actual exchange no-trade remains unresolved.

sampling.primary: For each predeclared horizon separately, retain an original pair iff event-entry, event-exit, control-entry and control-exit are exact-timestamp finite positive prices with source volume>0. Both event and control must also avoid a split/distribution crossing over that horizon.
sampling.gate_failure: Report counts/reasons for every horizon. Suppress that horizon's ETF outcomes if its fixed coverage test fails; do not tune gates. Outcome release is determined from availability before computing returns, not from returns.
sampling.alignment: Original index observation clock and frozen entry indices; never use ETF row offsets, nearest-price joins, clock shifts, fills or interpolation.
sampling.common_endpoint_sensitivity: Intersect all seven endpoint-eligible pair sets. If the same 80% pooled/per-year coverage gate passes, report all seven horizons on this identical common sample. Otherwise report insufficient common-sample coverage, no common-sample ETF outcome table.
sampling.composition_audit: For each horizon compute index-only returns on all original pairs, eligible pairs and excluded pairs, and all matching features/year/side composition. This diagnoses observable selection only and cannot identify unobserved ETF returns or remove bias.
sampling.corporate_actions: Exclude crossing when entry_day < ex_date <= horizon_exit_day for either leg, using unchanged delivered action tables.

measurements.short: synthetic signed price return, not actual borrow or execution
reports: all seven horizons, including unavailable cells
ETF event/control/increment mean median positive fraction zero fraction standard deviation quantiles
per-horizon coverage and explicit endpoint/action exclusions
common-endpoint sensitivity if its gate passes

execution: Publish this freeze before new endpoint outcomes; run synthetic and integration boundary tests first. Persist new endpoint evidence in a separate directory. Do not edit the original transport runner, v1 freeze, raw CSVs or prior decisive receipts. Update current handoff to distinguish endpoint measurement from old complete-path state.
